case_title.correct_value: Om Prakash v. State of Haryana
case_title.quote: A OM PRAKASH v. STATE OF HARYANA
case_title.reason: Case name is right, but the leading 'A' is a margin marker, not part of the title.

number_of_accused.reason: Three accused (Om Prakash, Kartar Singh, Chhoti) are named and tried.

accused_gender.quote: Accused Chhoti (wife of accused Kartar Singh)
accused_gender.reason: Value says all accused are male, but accused Chhoti is female.

accused_age.reason: No accused age appears in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of accused is not mentioned.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of accused is not mentioned.

accused_occupation.reason: Occupation of accused is not mentioned.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status of accused is not mentioned.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_age.reason: Victim's age is about 15, consistent with the school certificate date of birth.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: accused/appellant Chhoti came there and asked the prosecutrix to bring 'lassi'
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment does not describe any family or kinship relationship between accused and victim.

offence_category.reason: Offence is rape under Section 376(2)(g) IPC.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.376(2)(g), s.109, s.107; charge-sheet also cited s.342, s.506 r/w s.34
statutory_provisions.reason: Omits s.107, discussed as the abetment definition, and the charge-sheet sections 342, 506 and 34.

weapon.reason: No weapon is mentioned in the judgment.

evidence_type.correct_value: Victim testimony (PW5), mother's corroboration (PW6), radiological and medical reports, school certificate
evidence_type.reason: Medical and eyewitness evidence fit, but 'circumstantial' is unsupported; school and radiological age evidence is omitted.

confession.reason: No confession by any accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: The court does not identify aggravating circumstances.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: The judgment does not identify mitigating circumstances, only a plea for reduced sentence.

trial_court_outcome.quote: The trial court ... sentenced each one of the accused
trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted and sentenced all accused.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence affirmed
high_court_outcome.quote: was dismissed vide impugned judgment and order dated 30.7.2008
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court dismissed the appeal, so the outcome was not 'Not applicable'.

final_outcome.quote: all the three appeals are dismissed
final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeals, so convictions stand.

offence_finally_established.quote: Section 109 IPC for abetment as she aided the commission of rape
offence_finally_established.reason: Rape by two accused and abetment by Chhoti were upheld.

imprisonment_type.quote: to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of 10 years
imprisonment_type.reason: Sentences were rigorous imprisonment for fixed terms.

imprisonment_years.quote: Accused Chhoti was sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of three years
imprisonment_years.reason: 10 years applies only to two accused; Chhoti received three years.

fine_rs.reason: Fine of Rs. 10,000 is imposed on each accused.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts without the outcome sentence; the lure was by accused Chhoti, and she was not the rapist.
neutral_facts.quote: the court found the evidence credible and the accused guilty
neutral_facts.reason: Reveals the court outcome, which is prohibited; also attributes the lure to 'the accused' generally rather than Chhoti.

offence_severity.quote: rigorous imprisonment for a period of 10 years
offence_severity.reason: Statutory minimum and maximum are not stated; only the sentences imposed are given.

attempt_completion.quote: the victim was subjected to rape
attempt_completion.reason: Rape was completed, per the court's account of the incident.

physical_harm.correct_value: Healed ruptured hymen admitting one finger; no external injuries or marks on perineum or thighs; secondary sexual characters well developed
physical_harm.quote: secondary sexual characters of prosecutrix were found well developed
physical_harm.reason: Wrongly says development resulted from rape; the medical findings are the hymen rupture and no external injuries.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Charges under s.376 (two accused) and s.109 (one accused); three convictions upheld
number_of_offences.quote: charge was framed for the offence punishable under Section 376 IPC
number_of_offences.reason: Three convictions were upheld, but the charges were two provisions, not three offences.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is mentioned.

premeditation_planning.reason: Premeditation or planning is not characterised by the court.

motive.correct_value: Prosecution motive not stated; defence alleged enmity, with Kartar Singh suspected of spreading news of the victim's abortion
motive.quote: suspected that it was he (Kartar Singh) who spread the news
motive.reason: 'Not identified' ignores the defence's stated enmity and abortion-news motive.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the evidence adduced by the victim is natural and trustworthy
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Victim's evidence and Chhoti's aiding role were accepted, as stated.

witness_credibility.quote: nothing has come out to create reasonable doubt in their testimony
witness_credibility.reason: Both PW5 and PW6 survived lengthy cross-examination without reasonable doubt.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Victim delayed about 20 days before reporting; delay held sufficiently explained
post_offence_conduct.quote: sufficient explanation on record for the same
post_offence_conduct.reason: Delay in reporting is discussed and explained, so 'Not stated' misses it.

custody_duration.reason: Duration of custody before the appeal is not stated.

bail_history.quote: Accused Chhoti, Kartar Singh and Om Prakash were granted bail by this Court vide orders dated 18.5.2009
bail_history.reason: Bail dates are mismatched to the accused in the value.

trial_duration.quote: order dated 16.12.1996 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge
trial_duration.reason: Trial, High Court and Supreme Court dates match; offence date is not precisely stated.

legal_representation.quote: Rishi Malhotra, Prem Malhotra for the Appellant
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for appellant and respondent match the judgment.

investigation_status.quote: On 13.6.1995, first information report was registered
investigation_status.reason: FIR registration, investigation and charge-sheet are described; trial commenced.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is raised or noted.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court: convicted and sentenced; High Court: appeal dismissed, conviction affirmed; Supreme Court: appeals dismissed
appeal_history.quote: the trial court sentenced each one of the accused
appeal_history.reason: Trial court convicted and sentenced; it did not affirm anything on appeal.

prosecution_argument.quote: The prosecution case in brief is that
prosecution_argument.reason: Lure to Chhoti's house, rape, and evidence relied on are supported.

defence_argument.correct_value: All accused alleged enmity; Kartar Singh alleged false implication over abortion news; Chhoti challenged s.109 conviction, arguing failure to prevent is not abetment
defence_argument.quote: Accused Kartar Singh took a specific defence plea that he was falsely implicated
defence_argument.reason: Invents Chhoti's absence claim and omits Kartar's abortion-based defence; the abetment argument is correct.

legal_principle_applied.quote: Intentional aiding of the offence is covered by the third clause mentioned in Section 107 IPC.
legal_principle_applied.reason: Ss.107 and 109 principles, and mere failure to prevent not being abetment, are discussed.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Kulwant Singh @ Kulbansh Singh vs. State of Bihar (2007) 15 SCC 670
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Both precedents and their citations match the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.quote: the sentence awarded by the trial court as upheld by the High Court, is just and proper
sentencing_rationale.reason: Court upheld sentences as just and proper given the facts.

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: the sentence awarded by the trial court as upheld by the High Court, is just and proper
judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Judgment does not state that no mitigating factors existed; it only rejects reduction.

judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: considering the facts and circumstances of the case
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court does not state that no aggravating factors existed.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Accused directed to be taken into custody forthwith to serve out the remaining sentence
other_sentence_order.quote: shall be taken into custody forthwith to serve out the remaining of their sentence
other_sentence_order.reason: The judgment contains a custody direction, so 'None' is wrong.
